scope: NATIVE5 change gate and native workflow
reviewMode: Read-only source, local fixtures, parsed YAML and prior actual diagnostic evidence
separateGatePeerReview: /root/publication_prep/gate_review found no blocking issue; final empty-path, file-mode, invalid-UTF8 and guard truth-case updates reviewed

observations.nativeSkipping: Only successful complete exact before-to-head synchronize diff can skip; all ambiguity/failure requires compilation
observations.nativeWorkflow: No outer cumulative path filter or workflow/job concurrency; gate failure or absent output compiles unless canceled; exact source pinning and read permissions preserved
observations.inspectorRequiredRuntimeDeclarations: Enabled application, launcher and notification receiver/forwarder required; launcher/reminder intent topology and boot capability required
observations.startupScope: Provider authority and present initializer declarations restricted to three reviewed names/values; provider or initializer absence is intentionally optional
observations.iosSourceDenials: FaceID usage description must be absent; direct Documents exposure absent/default-false or explicit boolean false only
observations.native6Suppression: Exactly the eight prior actual MissingClass errors are annotated on tools:node=remove source markers; ninth removal and actual launcher remain unannotated; recursive typed attribute check rejects global or extra diagnostics; final APK remote-component denial remains unchanged

priorActualDiagnostic.scope: Prior compiled-source lint failure; not a passing current-source APK qualification

limits: Parsed YAML and restricted local guard truth cases are source-only checks, not the GitHub hosted event evaluator
Fixture declarations do not prove notification delivery, lifecycle, SDK reachability, or all runtime dependencies
Intentional optional AndroidX initializers do not imply binary implementation acceptance
Input-unchanged skip is not a successful prior build or a new binary qualification
Node-level lint suppression repair still needs fresh actual lint and final APK inspection
Signing, physical-device/privacy/backup behavior, dependency release blockers and store distribution remain independent gates
